title: pluf-lean: a Lean 4 verification of maximal filters in the projection lattice of a Hilbert space
description: A Lean 4 / Mathlib development machine-checking the theorems of a four-paper series on maximal filters in the projection lattice of a Hilbert space (plufs). 243 audited theorems, axiom footprint propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Four classical inputs (Mathias; Marcus-Spielman-Srivastava; Blecher-Weaver; Rowbottom) enter only as named hypotheses and are never discharged, so every mechanized statement is a theorem of ZFC. PAPERS.md maps each printed assertion of each paper to the Lean name that proves it.
